{{Quote|Hurry now, Padawan, Havac's scheme is afoot.|Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>}}
'''Havac''' was the code name given at various points to most of the leaders of the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]], especially its militant wing. The last (and best known) Havac was [[Eru Matalis]]; even his associates in the Front knew him only by the title.
